resources.string: Switch AirPods between this phone and Mac
Starts only after you enable and pair it. New media playback requests the most recent device; it does not automatically resume playback.
Uses nearby Bluetooth only. No audio, track title, or app name is shared.
Some apps or very short playback may be detected late or missed.
Waiting for Android approval… Open the AirPods case if the device does not appear.
This phone does not provide Android’s companion device setup feature.
Connect and select your AirPods in LibrePods first.
The selected AirPods is not currently paired with Android. Open its case and reconnect it first.
Android couldn’t open connection approval. Open the AirPods case and try again.
This Android version does not require the Android 17 approval step. Switching still depends on the phone’s available Bluetooth control and observed A2DP state.
Scan for a Mac running LibrePods My Handoff.
Connect and compare the code shown on both devices.
Clears the saved Mac connection. For a full reset, clear this phone on the Mac too.
Check that %1$s shows exactly %2$s. Approve on both devices only when they match.
This clears the saved Mac connection on this phone. Clear the phone connection on the Mac too before connecting again.
Turn on Bluetooth, then scan again.
The connection information doesn’t match the saved device. Reset the connection on both devices, then connect again.
This phone couldn’t open its saved connection information. Reset handoff here and clear the phone connection on the Mac.
Clears the saved connection. If its connection information is damaged, the phone creates it again; clear this phone on the Mac too.
Clear the phone connection on the Mac too before connecting again.
